apps.localizedDescription: Scan a barcode or search to find the Plaisio product code, price and store stock.
apps.versionDescription: Today: each customer you help is tracked. Products you open in Customer mode go in their list; End customer asks what they bought (tap it, then Sold) or Left without buying. Today's customers shows each one with what they looked at and bought.

privacy.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Adds your shifts to a Plaisio shifts calendar and keeps it up to date.
